top_choice_rationale: P001 awards a single GLP-1 achievement to Holst (secretion and actions in humans), Mojsov (the biologically active GLP-1(7-36) form) and Drucker (receptor pharmacology and therapeutic rationale). The mechanism is independently confirmed over decades and large randomized outcome trials show benefit in type 2 diabetes, obesity and increasingly cardiovascular and renal outcomes, so maturity is not in question. The citation, anchored in physiology and active molecular forms with the therapy as consequence, makes the exclusion of Knudsen a principled boundary between discovery and development, though the cost of that exclusion and the unverified Mojsov versus Habener priority remain real. No award is clearly inferior to this well-supported achievement.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no documented tie to the GLP-1 candidates (my documented co-authorship concerns spatial transcriptomics and single-cell work, not incretin biology)
